description.value:
Requirements You are veiled.

You strike a target and hinder their attempts to call for help. You teleport to a square within 60 feet and make a Strike against a creature; if you hit, it must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Regardless of the result, the target is then immune to your Hush for 24 hours.

Success The target is otherwise unaffected.

Failure The target takes @Damage[10d6[force]] damage, and the target is affected by a 2nd-rank silence spell for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target takes @Damage[15d6[untyped]] damage, and the target is affected by a 2nd-rank silence spell for 1 minute.
